Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> a '''resolution''' was passed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] to colonize the [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovered]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] in the [[Alaris Expanse]], a planetary system in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="SW:GB databank" /> [[Time/Legends|Sometime]] between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]],<ref name="NEC & GB">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' placed the [[Alaris Prime colonial war]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], and the ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' DataBank stated that the debate for the colonisation rights took place over a twenty [[Standard year/Legends|year]] period. Therefore, the [[Discovery of Alaris Prime]] must have taken place between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]].</ref> the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] who discovered the moon petitioned the Senate to give them the rights, and were represented by the [[Wookiee Chieftain|Wookiee Chieftan]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]],<ref name="SW:GB databank" /> representing the whole [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] also expressed interest in Alaris Prime, intending to use it as a trade center between other planets such as Kashyyyk, [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]]. After two [[Time/Legends|decades]] of slowly dispensing the rights, the Senate awarded the moon to the Wookiees, and Attichitcuk was given the honor of leading the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonization effort]] for his role in securing them. The Trade Federation, however, ignored the Senate's ruling and landed on Alaris Prime illegally, forcing the Wookiees to [[Alaris Prime colonial war|fight]] for the world.<ref name="SW:GB databank" /> The Wookiees also [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] the other seven moons of Alaris.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The resolution to give Alaris Prime's rights to the Wookiees was mentioned in the databank of the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', in the entries for Alaris Prime and Attichitcuk.<ref name="SW:GB databank" />
